Generate Python code based on the following instruction. Output ONLY code. DO NOT include explanations or other textual content.
Instruction: Generate code that creates a custom lithium-ion model using the pybamm library. The model should be named "my li-ion model" and should include submodels for the external circuit, current collector, thermal, porosity, electrolyte diffusion, electrolyte conductivity, SEI, SEI on cracks, and lithium plating. For both the negative and positive electrode domains, the model should include submodels for active material, electrode potential, particle, total particle concentration, open-circuit potential, interface, interface utilisation, interface current, surface potential difference, and particle mechanics. After defining the model, build it, create the geometry, process the model and geometry, set the mesh, discretise the model, and solve it. Finally, plot the solution dynamically.

import pybamm

# Create a custom lithium-ion model
model = pybamm.BaseModel(name="my li-ion model")

# Set up submodels
# External circuit
model.set_external_circuit_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["external circuit"]
)

# Current collector
model.set_current_collector_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["current collector"]
)

# Thermal
model.set_thermal_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["thermal"]
)

# Porosity
model.set_porosity_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["porosity"]
)

# Electrolyte diffusion
model.set_electrolyte_diffusion_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["electrolyte diffusion"]
)

# Electrolyte conductivity
model.set_electrolyte_conductivity_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["electrolyte conductivity"]
)

# SEI
model.set_sei_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["sei"]
)

# SEI on cracks
model.set_sei_on_cracks_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["sei on cracks"]
)

# Lithium plating
model.set_lithium_plating_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["lithium plating"]
)

# Negative electrode submodels
neg_domain = "negative"
model.set_active_material_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["active material"][neg_domain], domain=neg_domain
)
model.set_electrode_potential_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["electrode potential"][neg_domain], domain=neg_domain
)
model.set_particle_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["particle"][neg_domain], domain=neg_domain
)
model.set_total_particle_concentration_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["total particle concentration"][neg_domain], domain=neg_domain
)
model.set_open_circuit_potential_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["open-circuit potential"][neg_domain], domain=neg_domain
)
model.set_intercalation_kinetics_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["interface"][neg_domain], domain=neg_domain
)
model.set_interface_utilisation_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["interface utilisation"][neg_domain], domain=neg_domain
)
model.set_interface_current_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["interface current"][neg_domain], domain=neg_domain
)
model.set_surface_potential_difference_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["surface potential difference"][neg_domain], domain=neg_domain
)
model.set_particle_mechanics_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["particle mechanics"][neg_domain], domain=neg_domain
)

# Positive electrode submodels
pos_domain = "positive"
model.set_active_material_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["active material"][pos_domain], domain=pos_domain
)
model.set_electrode_potential_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["electrode potential"][pos_domain], domain=pos_domain
)
model.set_particle_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["particle"][pos_domain], domain=pos_domain
)
model.set_total_particle_concentration_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["total particle concentration"][pos_domain], domain=pos_domain
)
model.set_open_circuit_potential_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["open-circuit potential"][pos_domain], domain=pos_domain
)
model.set_intercalation_kinetics_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["interface"][pos_domain], domain=pos_domain
)
model.set_interface_utilisation_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["interface utilisation"][pos_domain], domain=pos_domain
)
model.set_interface_current_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["interface current"][pos_domain], domain=pos_domain
)
model.set_surface_potential_difference_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["surface potential difference"][pos_domain], domain=pos_domain
)
model.set_particle_mechanics_submodel(
    pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().submodels["particle mechanics"][pos_domain], domain=pos_domain
)

# Build the model
model.build_model()

# Create geometry
geometry = pybamm.lithium_ion.DFN().geometry

# Process model and geometry
param = pybamm.ParameterValues("Marquis2019")
param.process_model(model)
param.process_geometry(geometry)

# Set mesh
mesh = pybamm.Mesh(geometry, model.default_submesh_types, model.default_var_pts)

# Discretise the model
disc = pybamm.Discretisation(mesh, model.default_spatial_methods)
disc.process_model(model)

# Solve the model
t_eval = pybamm.linspace(0, 3600, 100)
solver = pybamm.CasadiSolver()
solution = solver.solve(model, t_eval)

# Plot the solution dynamically
pybamm.dynamic_plot(solution)
